$comment: What the engine and the Android application (outside engine/) exchange by name: the one home of these names
(tools/android/README.md). The Java natives need no entry: every APK build matches them with the Java_
functions the native libraries export (app/tools/android/build_apk.py).
engine_commands: the text commands of the UI library's game-interface screens the main loop takes
(platform/android_ui_commands.hpp kUiCommands); a prefix ends in ':' (or a tab), anything else is the whole
command. The activity's mailbox reaches the engine through typed natives of GameActivity.
hud_host_input: HUD actions the engine hands to the activity (onUiHudInput) and the values each may carry.
host_actions: UI actions without an engine command (onUiAction nodes, Bindings::SendHost).
state_channels: what each host writes into the UI (EngineUi/StormUi setState) and the UI consumes.
These three reach the code only as generated names: the engine's app_ui_names.hpp
(cmake/StormAppContract.cmake) and the application's AppNames (app/tools/android/app_contract.py).
settings: the settings screen's application keys; the About screen's (about_keys: stored by the launcher, read
by the engine at its start and at each return to the foreground, never sent by the settings screen); the steps
and default of the display options and switches (ui_scale: the percent of the display density the UI lays out
at, 100 the smallest because the screens are designed to 48 dp targets there; hud_transparency: the percent the
HUD buttons are see-through beyond their design); the facts
the host reports beside them; the debug overrides of a debuggable build with the values the screen offers
(-1 = the preset decides; bench: a one-shot request of the renderer bench, 1 full, 2 quick, never stored).
Generated into app_ui_names.hpp and AppNames like the three above.
script_events: events the engine raises that the application's interface scripts (mobile-ui/PROGRAM)
handle, with the arguments the engine passes; the engine raises them through the header generated from this
list (cmake/StormAppContract.cmake), the application's tests/engine_contract finds their handlers.
jni.upcalls: Java methods the engine looks up, class (of org.stormengine.port), name and JNI descriptor.
archive_status: the codes the archive reader returns (NativeArchives), by name: the C enum of
android/archive/storm_archive.h (STORM_ARCHIVE_<name>) and the application's ArchiveStatus are generated from it.
